mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) FROM rag_document WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status != #{excludedStatus}
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_document SET document_group_id = #{groupId} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE rag_document SET document_group_id = #{groupId} WHERE id = #{id} AND document_group_id IS NULL
UPDATE rag_document SET superseded_by = #{newDocId} WHERE id = #{oldDocId} AND superseded_by IS NULL
UPDATE rag_document SET document_group_id = #{groupId}, version = #{version} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE rag_document SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', superseded_by = #{newDocId} WHERE id = #{oldDocId} AND superseded_by IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_name, file_size, mime_type, storage_key, bucket, user_id, chunk_count, status, error_message, file_checksum, team_id, version, superseded_by, document_group_id, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM rag_document WHERE superseded_by IS NOT NULL AND status != 'SUPERSEDED' AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, user_id, team_id FROM rag_document WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND entity_extracted_at IS NULL AND update_time < NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours' ORDER BY update_time
LIMIT #{limit}
